design_rules.review_policy: Each unit reuses earlier vocabulary and patterns before adding new material.

unit_session_template.name: Learn
unit_session_template.purpose: Introduce new words, pronunciation, pinyin, and first sentence pattern.

unit_session_template.name: Build
unit_session_template.purpose: Build Chinese from English and English from Chinese using controlled tiles.

unit_session_template.name: Listen
unit_session_template.purpose: Train audio recognition, tone/pinyin discrimination, and short sentence listening.

unit_session_template.name: Review
unit_session_template.purpose: Mixed review with older material, short output, and mission-style checks.

new_word_card.interaction: tap character to hear audio; reveal meaning

pinyin_choice.interaction: hear or see character, choose pinyin

flash_choice.interaction: choose the matching Traditional Chinese item

dictation_tiles.interaction: listen and build what was heard

speaking_repeat.interaction: play audio, record or self-check pronunciation

implementation_phases.name: Structure
implementation_phases.scope: Course schema, section/unit map, session templates, exercise contract.

implementation_phases.name: Content Payloads
implementation_phases.scope: Fill vocabulary, grammar, dialogue, listening, reading, speaking, writing, and review payloads for each unit.

implementation_phases.name: Engine Integration
implementation_phases.scope: Load structure and payloads into Learning Mode instead of hardcoded units.

implementation_phases.name: Audio and Speech
implementation_phases.scope: Map local pinyin/word audio first, TTS fallback second, speech recognition timeout and skip flow.

implementation_phases.name: QA
implementation_phases.scope: Validate each unit has 4 sessions, 50+ exercises, correct answer coverage, no level jumps, mobile one-screen fit.
